result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with no critical issues. One minor visual issue was identified.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') has its name text clipped mid-word at the card boundary, but unlike the card image edge clipping (which is expected for carousels), the restaurant name text below the card is also truncated without an ellipsis, making it appear broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis to the restaurant name label beneath carousel cards so truncated names display with '...' rather than cutting off abruptly mid-word.
